exclusion_policy: Excluded files remain local and ignored; no loss of original user sources. All originals backed up outside the repository during audit. New source resources are listed separately in source/resources.json.

secrets_review.inspection: Read all199 original files; recursively expanded Base64/GZip/ZIP, inspected UTF-8/UTF-16/CP1251 and decoded native PLC images. Credential assignment candidates manually reviewed as documentation or synthetic tests.
not_published: Actual passwords or group authorization keys
Vendor executables, reference assemblies or license files
Old MBP configuration containing unrelated access configuration
secrets_review.caveat: Automated pattern scans do not guarantee detection of every possible secret; no credential-bearing configuration was intentionally added.
